name: io.github.astyboyy-ship-it/bloom-exchange
description: Negotiate in a double-blind sandbox and verify Ed25519 receipts. Agent-to-agent clearing over A2A.

environmentVariables.name: BLOOM_EXCHANGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Bloom Exchange node (default http://localhost:3000)

environmentVariables.name: BLOOM_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Bloom access key for production enclaves instead of the sandbox

environmentVariables.name: BLOOM_AGENT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: How this client's agent introduces itself to the counterparty
